verification_level: FAST plus the full library suite. Two bounded mechanisms in src/cms/cms_enc.rs: AEAD parameters become one validated type and the fetched cipher/BIO get scoped ownership. No cms_enc.rs file outside those mechanisms was touched; src/evp/cipher_ctx.rs unchanged. No new hidden obligation, no ABI/layout/export change, no allocator-seam size/file/line change.
scope: src/cms/cms_enc.rs: ossl_cms_EncryptedContent_init_bio, its AEAD parameter handling and its fetched-cipher/BIO ownership. The decode parameter staging struct (EvpCipherAeadAsn1Params) remains the cipher_ctx bridge shape and is never used for a copy or provider call before validation.

mechanisms.class: oversized AEAD IV / malformed tag length (CVE-2025-15467 mechanism) made inexpressible

before.shape: loose coupling of a [u8; EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH] local, a *mut u8 piv, an ivlen c_int, an EvpCipherAeadAsn1Params staging struct, and ec->taglen; the bounds were four separate checks spread across both directions and one raw copy (from_raw_parts(piv, ivlen) -> slice copy).
checks: enc: ivlen < 0 and iv_length_fits_authority_buffer(ivlen) before RAND_bytes_ex
enc: aparams.tag_len == 0 after the provider reports it

after.type: AeadParams { iv: [c_uchar; EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH], iv_len: c_int, tag_len: c_int } — private fields; construction is the only entry point.
constructors: new_for_encryption(libctx, iv_len): rejects negative/>16 IV lengths BEFORE RAND_bytes_ex writes, then fills exactly iv_len bytes; Err(Random) preserves the authority's no-raise RAND failure.

decode(raw, cipher_iv_len, tag_len): establishes raw.iv_len <= 16, the provider-advertised cipher_iv_len in 0..=16, and tag_len in 4..=16 before any copy or provider call; checks in the authority's order (parsed IV, provider IV, tag).
set_tag_len(tag_len): establishes the encode-side tag bound (> 0) before the ASN.1 encoder reads it.
exits: piv(): the only IV pointer handed to EVP_CipherInit_ex; NULL when iv_len == 0, matching the authority's piv.
bridge(): the only EvpCipherAeadAsn1Params the encoder sees; iv/iv_len/tag_len are already validated and the IV bytes are the ones this call generated.
after.copy_eliminated: The encode-side memcpy(piv -> aparams.iv) is replaced by the type holding the generated IV itself; the observable IV bytes and the encoded iv_len/tag_len are unchanged.
after.error_ordering: dec IV failures keep cms_enc.c:103's CMS_R_CIPHER_PARAMETER_INITIALISATION_ERROR; tag failures keep :115's CMS_R_CIPHER_AEAD_SET_TAG_ERROR; enc IV failures keep :92's ERR_R_EVP_LIB; the encode tag_len == 0 failure remains an unraised goto-err equivalent. AeadRefusal::TagLength is the only variant that selects :115, so the decode order (IV first, tag second) is preserved.

eliminated: A raw slice constructed from piv with a caller-chosen length at the encode copy site.
The possibility of handing EVP_CipherInit_ex a provider-advertised IV extent outside the fixed buffer.
The possibility of handing EVP_CTRL_AEAD_SET_TAG a tag length outside 4..=16 (and of calling it at all for an out-of-range length).
relocated: The fixed 16-byte IV extent and both AEAD lengths now live in AeadParams; the raw staging struct is only the cipher_ctx parser's output buffer.

mechanisms.class: manual multi-path cleanup of the fetched cipher and the cipher BIO

before.shape: fetched_ciph: *mut EvpCipher and b: *mut Bio with 13 repeated EVP_CIPHER_free/BIO_free pairs across the early-exit paths and the final err label.
before.sites: 26 free calls in the function body (git show HEAD:src/cms/cms_enc.rs lines 75-518).

types: FetchedCipher(*mut EvpCipher) — Drop releases exactly once; initialized to NONE and set once from EVP_CIPHER_fetch.
CipherBio(*mut Bio) — Drop releases exactly once; into_raw() is the single ownership transfer for the success return.
after.sites: 0 free calls in the function body; exactly one EVP_CIPHER_free in FetchedCipher::drop and one BIO_free in CipherBio::drop.
contracts: FetchedCipher: the field is NULL or the cipher this call fetched and has not released; Drop is the authority's cms_enc.c:199.
CipherBio: the field is NULL or the BIO this call created, neither transferred nor released; Drop is cms_enc.c:207 and into_raw is the return-b transfers ownership.

eliminated: Every hand-written early-exit cleanup pair; a newly added early return can no longer forget a release or repeat one.
relocated: The two release mechanisms are confined to two narrow Drop impls with stated provenance.

function_body_occurrences.note: 'unsafe' token count in the function range; the reduction does not include the 7 new #[cfg(test)] tests.

eliminated: raw from_raw_parts IV copy at the encode site
relocated: the parser's bounded write into EvpCipherAeadAsn1Params (cipher_ctx.rs unchanged, already bounds by 16)
EVP_CTRL_AEAD_SET_TAG's tag read (still trusts ec->tag readable for the validated ≤16 bytes)
EVP_CipherInit_ex's IV read through piv (validated extent)
introduced: AeadParams::new_for_encryption unsafe call (libctx live; bound established before RAND)
two Drop impls (provenance contract stated above)
test-only fake-provider callbacks and raw field writes in #[cfg(test)]

graduation: OWNERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTED (scoped). Not SAFETY_DISCHARGED: the tag read at EVP_CTRL_AEAD_SET_TAG still relies on the ABI contract that ec->tag is readable for the validated length, and EVP_CipherInit_ex remains a provider edge whose IV extent is established but whose internal behaviour is the provider's.
residuals: Encode-side set_tag_len accepts any positive provider tag length, preserving the authority's `tag_len <= 0` check; it additionally refuses a negative c_int, which the authority would cast to unsigned int and encode. This deviation is not reachable through the crate's EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_tag_length (which answers 0 on failure) and is recorded as a §17 safety improvement.
The decode-side ec->tag pointer is trusted for the validated tag length (4..=16); the parser/ABI contract, not this function, establishes that extent.

AeadParams::decode keeps the parsed-IV check (raw.iv_len <= 16) even though evp_cipher_get_asn1_aead_params already bounds it; this is deliberate defence in depth against a future change to the bridge.

The unusual-tag-length test uses a hand-built method with a non-null provider marker and a test-only get_ctx_params; the marker is cleared before EVP_CIPHER_meth_free, so no provider pointer is dereferenced or freed. It is a dispatch-shape test, not a registered provider.
No differential transcript against the authority was produced at this level; the byte-level ASN.1 output of the AES-128-CBC success path is not compared here.
non_claims: This does not discharge the whole src/cms unsafe surface or any consumer family's dependency closure.
The two Drop impls are single-release guarantees for the values this function creates; they do not assert the wider BIO/cipher reference-count protocol of their consumers.
The canary is a test-only witness of the reachability of the pre-fix extent; it is not a memory-safety proof of the authority.
